name: Eggplant

schedule.notes: Bottom heat 80 to 85 F. Slowest of the solanums to germinate.
Hates cold soil — wait for 65+ F and overnight lows over 60 F.
Pick young, glossy. Dull skin = past prime, bitter.

harvest.cues: Skin is glossy and presses back when squeezed gently. Cut with shears, leaving 1 in of stem.
harvest.storageNotes: Counter at 50 to 55 F — fridge causes pitting. Use within a week.

varieties.name: Black Beauty
varieties.notes: Classic teardrop. Hold off harvest until 6 in.

varieties.name: Rosa Bianca
varieties.notes: Pink and white, mild and creamy.

varieties.name: Ichiban
varieties.notes: Slender purple, prolific. Doesn't need peeling.

notes: Heat-lover; below 60 F nights and growth stalls. Row covers off until flowering. Stake or cage — fruit-loaded plants tip.
